root_causes.detail: The private Milvus copy directory did not end in .db, so pymilvus rejected it before retrieval.
Empty MCP URL strings still produced configured MCP servers, causing failed discovery attempts.
The production structured-output path requested tool_choice; deepseek-flash replies that thinking mode does not support this tool_choice.

notes: No case-level answer was produced. The attempt is retained rather than overwritten; the infrastructure retry uses a new attempt number and the same protection ledger.
